## Changes since `v0.7.2-beta.6`

### Features

- offer a way out when a local tab's shell fails to start: a bar over the terminal shows why and lets the user edit their shell right there and start it again, try again, or open the default shell in the same directory instead of a tab with only an error in it ([9413d565](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/9413d565c91cb21638fe5663c21ec7c4d5482464))
- read quotes in a custom shell's arguments: they were split at every space, so a quoted path or command fell apart; double quotes now keep a word whole everywhere, and on macOS and Linux single quotes and backslashes work as in a POSIX shell, while on Windows a backslash stays a path separator ([9618be64](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/9618be6488adc2602c79bfe0cba163a202ff116e))
- manage local shells in Settings and pick from them wherever a local tab opens: a Local shells page lists Auto, the shells found here and the user's own, stars the default, hides found ones from the new tab list or copies one to add arguments, and adds or edits a shell with a file picker and a live check of the program it starts; the new tab list shows the default first and the user's shells after the found ones; a local terminal in the connection dialog picks from the same list or takes a program typed in, which it adds to the list or makes the default only when asked, as there was no way to set the default before; a restored tab follows its shell's later edits ([476cd991](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/476cd991d63f94967d7d20a7e70e2166443d6f76))
- keep a list of the user's own local shells in the settings, per device: a shell has a name, a program and arguments, the default can be one of them by id while its path and arguments stay in the old fields that older versions read, detected shells can be hidden from the new tab list, an older custom default becomes the first entry, a backup from another device adds only the shells found here and keeps this device's default when its own isn't, and check_local_shell tells the settings where a program path leads before a tab tries it ([7e4b78be](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/7e4b78beda5d681ed72f8a8a5bc18cbf084556de))
- let Auto start PowerShell on Windows and accept custom shell paths as users write them: Auto took %COMSPEC%, which is nearly always cmd, so PowerShell 7 and Windows PowerShell were never reached; it now tries PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell, %COMSPEC% and cmd, in their install locations before PATH so a PATH entry on an unreachable share can't hold up a tab, and finds the shell once; a custom path may be quoted, as Explorer's Copy as path gives it, use %VARIABLES% and ~, or be a name on PATH without .exe, and one that isn't there is reported in words instead of as a spawn error ([8ed2abfe](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/8ed2abfe138fc073230fc2fb6d2e833ba83e228e))

### Fixes

- reach shell_integration through super:: when restoring a Windows tab's directory: the module is declared in terminal/mod.rs, so the bare path in pty.rs did not resolve and the Windows build failed ([2f1e416e](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/2f1e416e84ceb2ce8e637a733c4902a981539c41))
- open the default shell in the first tab at startup and from the empty window's Local terminal button: both opened a tab without a shell, which the backend starts as Auto, so a default chosen in the settings was ignored there ([e206548d](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e206548da37084ead17d93bc2491365772d1baad))
- start the shell chosen for a local tab on macOS and Linux: the picker offered zsh, bash, fish and a custom path there, but the backend always started the login shell; a chosen shell without arguments now starts as a login shell and becomes $SHELL, so tTerm's integration, tmux and vim's :sh use it, one with arguments starts as given, a name is looked up on the login shell's PATH (which also finds Homebrew shells for the list), a missing one is reported instead of replaced, and the list, which waits for that PATH, runs off the main thread ([65647cc9](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/65647cc9e6a8afd5e41c6113e06979bad0903bf4))

**Full comparison:** [v0.7.2-beta.6...v0.7.2-beta.7](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/compare/v0.7.2-beta.6...v0.7.2-beta.7)
